<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8" />
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0" />
<title>Insurance - Nexcall Solution</title>
<meta name="description" content="Compare rates from top-rated carriers and get connected with a licensed local agent — free, fast, and no obligation." />
<link rel="icon" type="image/png" href="images/logo.png">
<link rel="apple-touch-icon" href="images/logo.png">
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com">
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.gstatic.com" crossorigin>
<link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Fraunces:wght@600;700&family=Space+Grotesk:wght@500;600;700&family=Inter:wght@400;500;600;700&family=IBM+Plex+Mono:wght@500;600&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">
<style>
/* ============================================
   NEXCALL SOLUTION — design tokens
   ============================================ */
:root {
  /* base surfaces are now light; header/hero/footer opt back into navy via .dark-surface */
  --bg: #FAFAF8;
  --bg-alt: #F1F1EC;
  --bg-card: #FFFFFF;
  --border: rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.08);
  --border-strong: rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.12);

  --text: #10131F;
  --text-muted: #5C6478;
  --text-dim: #939AB9;

  --accent: #00A88A;
  --accent-dim: rgba(0, 168, 138, 0.12);
  --accent-ink: #FFFFFF;
  --warm: #E77A2E;

  /* navy tokens reserved for header / hero / footer */
  --navy: #0B0F1E;
  --navy-alt: #12182C;
  --navy-card: #161D33;
  --navy-border: rgba(244, 246, 251, 0.08);
  --navy-border-strong: rgba(244, 246, 251, 0.14);
  --navy-text: #F4F6FB;
  --navy-text-muted: #8D96B3;
  --navy-text-dim: #5D6785;
  --navy-accent: #00E5B4;
  --navy-accent-dim: rgba(0, 229, 180, 0.14);

  --font-display: "Space Grotesk", sans-serif;
  --font-body: "Inter", sans-serif;
  --font-mono: "IBM Plex Mono", monospace;

  --radius-sm: 10px;
  --radius-md: 16px;
  --radius-lg: 26px;
  --shadow-lg: 0 24px 60px -24px rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.16);
}

/* Scoped dark bookend: header, hero, final-CTA and footer opt into navy;
   everything else (quote form, process, services, why-us) stays on the
   light base tokens defined above. */
.dark-surface {
  --bg: var(--navy);
  --bg-alt: var(--navy-alt);
  --bg-card: var(--navy-card);
  --border: var(--navy-border);
  --border-strong: var(--navy-border-strong);
  --text: var(--navy-text);
  --text-muted: var(--navy-text-muted);
  --text-dim: var(--navy-text-dim);
  --accent: var(--navy-accent);
  --accent-dim: var(--navy-accent-dim);
  --accent-ink: #06251E;
  --shadow-lg: 0 30px 80px -30px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.6);
  background: var(--navy);
  color: var(--navy-text);
}

.pistachio-surface {
  --bg: #9FE8CE;
  --bg-alt: #8CDFC0;
  --bg-card: #FFFFFF;
  --border: rgba(16, 19, 31, 0.14);
  --border-strong: rgba(16, 19, 31, 0.24);
  --text: #10131F;
  --text-muted: rgba(16, 19, 31, 0.72);
  --text-dim: rgba(16, 19, 31, 0.52);
  --accent: #10131F;
  --accent-dim: rgba(16, 19, 31, 0.08);
  --accent-ink: #FFFFFF;
  --shadow-lg: 0 30px 80px -30px rgba(16, 19, 31, 0.3);
  background: #9FE8CE;
  color: #10131F;
}
.pistachio-surface .nav-link:hover { background: rgba(16, 19, 31, 0.06); }

* { box-sizing: border-box; }
html { scroll-behavior: smooth; }

@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
  html { scroll-behavior: auto; }
  *, *::before, *::after { animation-duration: 0.001ms !important; animation-iteration-count: 1 !important; transition-duration: 0.001ms !important; }
}

body {
  margin: 0;
  background: var(--bg);
  color: var(--text);
  font-family: var(--font-body);
  line-height: 1.55;
  -webkit-font-smoothing: antialiased;
}

.container {
  max-width: 1180px;
  margin: 0 auto;
  padding: 0 24px;
}

h1, h2, h3 {
  font-family: var(--font-display);
  font-weight: 600;
  line-height: 1.15;
  margin: 0 0 0.5em;
  letter-spacing: -0.01em;
}

p { color: var(--text-muted); margin: 0 0 1em; }

a { color: inherit; text-decoration: none; }

:focus-visible {
  outline: 2px solid var(--accent);
  outline-offset: 3px;
}

.eyebrow {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 8px;
  font-family: var(--font-mono);
  font-size: 12.5px;
  letter-spacing: 0.08em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  color: var(--accent);
  background: var(--accent-dim);
  border: 1px solid rgba(0, 229, 180, 0.25);
  padding: 6px 14px;
  border-radius: 100px;
  margin-bottom: 18px;
}
.eyebrow .flag { font-size: 14px; }

.hl { color: var(--accent); }

/* ============ Buttons ============ */
.btn {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  gap: 8px;
  font-family: var(--font-body);
  font-weight: 600;
  font-size: 14.5px;
  padding: 13px 24px;
  border-radius: 100px;
  border: 1px solid transparent;
  cursor: pointer;
  white-space: nowrap;
  transition: transform 0.15s ease, box-shadow 0.15s ease, background 0.15s ease, border-color 0.15s ease;
}
.btn:hover { transform: translateY(-1px); }
.btn-accent {
  background: var(--accent);
  color: var(--accent-ink);
  box-shadow: 0 8px 24px -8px rgba(0, 229, 180, 0.55);
}
.btn-accent:hover { box-shadow: 0 12px 30px -8px rgba(0, 229, 180, 0.7); }
.btn-ghost {
  background: transparent;
  color: var(--text);
  border-color: var(--border-strong);
}
.btn-ghost:hover { border-color: var(--accent); color: var(--accent); }
.btn-lg { padding: 16px 30px; font-size: 15.5px; }
.btn-sm { padding: 10px 18px; font-size: 13.5px; }
.btn-block { width: 100%; }

/* ============ Header ============ */
.site-header {
  position: sticky;
  top: 0;
  z-index: 100;
  background: #9FE8CE;
  border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(16, 19, 31, 0.12);
}
.header-inner {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between;
  gap: 24px;
  height: 78px;
  position: relative;
}
.logo {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 10px;
  color: var(--text);
}
.logo-mark { color: var(--accent); display: flex; }
.logo-img { width: 32px; height: 32px; border-radius: 8px; object-fit: cover; display: block; }
.logo-full-img { height: 42px; width: auto; display: block; }
.logo-text {
  font-family: 'Fraunces', serif;
  font-weight: 700;
  font-size: 22px;
  letter-spacing: 0;
}
.logo-text em { font-style: normal; }

.main-nav {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 6px;
  flex: 1;
  justify-content: center;
}
.nav-item { position: relative; }
.nav-link {
  background: none;
  border: none;
  color: var(--text-muted);
  font-family: var(--font-body);
  font-size: 14.5px;
  font-weight: 500;
  padding: 10px 14px;
  border-radius: 8px;
  cursor: pointer;
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 6px;
  transition: color 0.15s ease, background 0.15s ease;
}
.nav-link:hover { color: var(--text); background: rgba(255,255,255,0.04); }

.dropdown {
  position: absolute;
  top: calc(100% + 8px);
  left: 0;
  background: var(--bg-card);
  border: 1px solid var(--border-strong);
  border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
  padding: 10px;
  min-width: 200px;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 2px;
  opacity: 0;
  visibility: hidden;
  transform: translateY(6px);
  transition: all 0.18s ease;
  box-shadow: var(--shadow-lg);
}
.dropdown.two-col { min-width: 380px; display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; }
.nav-item:hover .dropdown { opacity: 1; visibility: visible; transform: translateY(0); }
.dropdown a {
  padding: 8px 12px;
  border-radius: 6px;
  font-size: 14px;
  color: var(--text-muted);
}
.dropdown a:hover { background: var(--accent-dim); color: var(--accent); }

.header-actions { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; }
.phone-pill {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 8px;
  font-family: var(--font-mono);
  font-size: 13.5px;
  color: var(--text);
  border: 1px solid var(--border-strong);
  padding: 9px 16px;
  border-radius: 100px;
}
.phone-pill svg { color: var(--warm); }
.phone-pill:hover { border-color: var(--warm); }

.menu-toggle {
  display: none;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 5px;
  background: none;
  border: none;
  cursor: pointer;
  padding: 6px;
}
.menu-toggle span { width: 22px; height: 2px; background: var(--text); border-radius: 2px; }

/* ============ Hero ============ */
.hero {
  position: relative;
  padding: 96px 0;
  overflow: hidden;
}
.hero-bg {
  position: absolute;
  inset: 0;
  z-index: 0;
  background:
    radial-gradient(ellipse 700px 500px at 85% 10%, rgba(0, 229, 180, 0.14), transparent 60%),
    radial-gradient(ellipse 600px 400px at 5% 90%, rgba(255, 159, 91, 0.08), transparent 60%);
}
.signal-lines {
  position: absolute;
  inset: 0;
  display: flex;
  align-items: flex-end;
  justify-content: space-evenly;
  opacity: 0.35;
  padding-bottom: 0;
}
.signal-lines span {
  width: 1px;
  background: linear-gradient(to top, var(--accent), transparent);
  height: 20%;
  animation: signalPulse 3.4s ease-in-out infinite;
}
.signal-lines span:nth-child(1) { animation-delay: 0s; height: 30%; }
.signal-lines span:nth-child(2) { animation-delay: 0.3s; height: 55%; }
.signal-lines span:nth-child(3) { animation-delay: 0.6s; height: 20%; }
.signal-lines span:nth-child(4) { animation-delay: 0.9s; height: 70%; }
.signal-lines span:nth-child(5) { animation-delay: 1.2s; height: 40%; }
.signal-lines span:nth-child(6) { animation-delay: 1.5s; height: 60%; }
.signal-lines span:nth-child(7) { animation-delay: 1.8s; height: 25%; }
@keyframes signalPulse {
  0%, 100% { transform: scaleY(0.6); opacity: 0.3; }
  50% { transform: scaleY(1); opacity: 0.7; }
}

.hero-inner {
  position: relative;
  z-index: 1;
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: 1.1fr 0.9fr;
  gap: 60px;
  align-items: center;
}
.hero-copy h1 {
  font-size: clamp(32px, 4vw, 50px);
  max-width: 620px;
}
.hero-sub { font-size: 17px; max-width: 520px; }
.hero-cta-row { display: flex; gap: 14px; flex-wrap: wrap; margin: 28px 0 30px; }
.hero-cta-row.center { justify-content: center; }

.trust-badges {
  list-style: none;
  padding: 0;
  margin: 0;
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: nowrap;
  gap: 20px;
}
.trust-badges li {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 8px;
  font-size: 13px;
  color: var(--text-muted);
  font-weight: 500;
  white-space: nowrap;
}
.trust-badges .check {
  width: 18px;
  height: 18px;
  border-radius: 50%;
  flex-shrink: 0;
  background: var(--accent-dim);
  border: 1px solid var(--accent);
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
}
.trust-badges .check svg { color: var(--accent); display: block; }
@media (max-width: 640px) {
  .trust-badges { flex-wrap: wrap; }
  .trust-badges li { white-space: normal; }
}

/* --- Signature: connecting call card --- */
.hero-visual { display: flex; justify-content: center; }
.call-card {
  width: 100%;
  max-width: 340px;
  background: linear-gradient(180deg, var(--bg-card), var(--bg-alt));
  border: 1px solid var(--border-strong);
  border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
  padding: 28px 26px 24px;
  box-shadow: var(--shadow-lg);
}
.call-card-top {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 8px;
  font-family: var(--font-mono);
  font-size: 12.5px;
  color: var(--text-muted);
  margin-bottom: 26px;
}
.dot {
  width: 7px; height: 7px; border-radius: 50%;
  background: var(--accent);
  box-shadow: 0 0 0 0 rgba(0,229,180,0.6);
  animation: dotPulse 1.6s infinite;
}
@keyframes dotPulse {
  0% { box-shadow: 0 0 0 0 rgba(0,229,180,0.55); }
  70% { box-shadow: 0 0 0 8px rgba(0,229,180,0); }
  100% { box-shadow: 0 0 0 0 rgba(0,229,180,0); }
}

.ring-wrap {
  position: relative;
  width: 120px;
  height: 120px;
  margin: 0 auto 24px;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
}
.ring {
  position: absolute;
  border-radius: 50%;
  border: 1.5px solid var(--accent);
  opacity: 0;
  animation: ringExpand 2.4s ease-out infinite;
}
.ring.r1 { width: 60px; height: 60px; animation-delay: 0s; }
.ring.r2 { width: 60px; height: 60px; animation-delay: 0.8s; }
.ring.r3 { width: 60px; height: 60px; animation-delay: 1.6s; }
@keyframes ringExpand {
  0% { width: 60px; height: 60px; opacity: 0.7; }
  100% { width: 120px; height: 120px; opacity: 0; }
}
.ring-core {
  position: relative;
  z-index: 1;
  width: 60px;
  height: 60px;
  border-radius: 50%;
  background: var(--accent);
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  box-shadow: 0 0 30px rgba(0, 229, 180, 0.5);
}

.wave { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 3px; height: 32px; margin-bottom: 22px; }
.wave span {
  width: 3px;
  background: var(--text-dim);
  border-radius: 2px;
  animation: waveMove 1.2s ease-in-out infinite;
}
.wave span:nth-child(odd) { background: var(--accent); opacity: 0.7; }
.wave span:nth-child(1) { height: 30%; animation-delay: 0s; }
.wave span:nth-child(2) { height: 60%; animation-delay: 0.1s; }
.wave span:nth-child(3) { height: 90%; animation-delay: 0.2s; }
.wave span:nth-child(4) { height: 45%; animation-delay: 0.3s; }
.wave span:nth-child(5) { height: 70%; animation-delay: 0.4s; }
.wave span:nth-child(6) { height: 100%; animation-delay: 0.5s; }
.wave span:nth-child(7) { height: 55%; animation-delay: 0.6s; }
.wave span:nth-child(8) { height: 80%; animation-delay: 0.7s; }
.wave span:nth-child(9) { height: 40%; animation-delay: 0.8s; }
.wave span:nth-child(10) { height: 65%; animation-delay: 0.9s; }
.wave span:nth-child(11) { height: 35%; animation-delay: 1s; }
.wave span:nth-child(12) { height: 55%; animation-delay: 1.1s; }
@keyframes waveMove {
  0%, 100% { transform: scaleY(0.5); }
  50% { transform: scaleY(1); }
}

.call-card-bottom { border-top: 1px solid var(--border); padding-top: 16px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 10px; }
.match-row { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; font-size: 13px; font-family: var(--font-mono); }
.match-row .label { color: var(--text-dim); }
.match-row .value { color: var(--text); }
.match-row .value.accent { color: var(--accent); }

/* ============ Quote form ============ */
.quote-section { padding: 96px 0; background: var(--bg-alt); border-top: 1px solid var(--border); border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border); }
.quote-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 0.9fr 1.1fr; gap: 70px; align-items: start; }
.quote-intro h2 { font-size: clamp(26px, 3vw, 34px); }
.mini-stats { display: flex; gap: 34px; margin-top: 32px; }
.mini-stats strong { display: block; font-family: var(--font-display); font-size: 24px; color: var(--accent); }
.mini-stats span { font-size: 12.5px; color: var(--text-muted); font-family: var(--font-mono); }

.quote-form {
  background: var(--bg-card);
  border: 1px solid var(--border-strong);
  border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
  padding: 34px;
  box-shadow: var(--shadow-lg);
}
.form-progress { margin-bottom: 26px; }
.step-label { font-family: var(--font-mono); font-size: 12px; color: var(--accent); letter-spacing: 0.04em; text-transform: uppercase; }
.progress-track { height: 4px; background: var(--border); border-radius: 4px; margin-top: 10px; overflow: hidden; }
.progress-fill { height: 100%; width: 33.3%; background: var(--accent); border-radius: 4px; transition: width 0.35s ease; }

.form-step { display: none; }
.form-step.active { display: block; animation: stepIn 0.3s ease; }
@keyframes stepIn { from { opacity: 0; transform: translateX(8px); } to { opacity: 1; transform: translateX(0); } }
.form-step h3 { font-size: 19px; margin-bottom: 20px; }

.choice-row { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; gap: 12px; margin-bottom: 20px; }
.choice-card {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 8px;
  padding: 20px 12px;
  background: var(--bg-alt);
  border: 1px solid var(--border-strong);
  border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
  color: var(--text-muted);
  font-family: var(--font-body);
  font-weight: 600;
  font-size: 14px;
  cursor: pointer;
  transition: all 0.15s ease;
}
.choice-card svg { color: var(--text-muted); transition: color 0.15s ease; }
.choice-card:hover { border-color: var(--border-strong); }
.choice-card.selected { border-color: var(--accent); background: var(--accent-dim); color: var(--accent); }
.choice-card.selected svg { color: var(--accent); }

.field { display: block; margin-bottom: 18px; }
.field span { display: block; font-size: 13px; color: var(--text-muted); margin-bottom: 8px; font-weight: 500; }
.field input, .field select {
  width: 100%;
  background: var(--bg-alt);
  border: 1px solid var(--border-strong);
  color: var(--text);
  font-family: var(--font-body);
  font-size: 14.5px;
  padding: 12px 14px;
  border-radius: 10px;
  transition: border-color 0.15s ease;
}
.field input:focus, .field select:focus { border-color: var(--accent); outline: none; }
.field input::placeholder { color: var(--text-dim); }

.form-nav { display: flex; gap: 12px; margin-top: 8px; }
.form-nav .btn-ghost { flex: 0 0 auto; }
.form-nav .btn-accent { flex: 1; }

.fine-print { font-size: 12px; color: var(--text-dim); margin: 4px 0 18px; }
.fine-print a { color: var(--accent); font-weight: 600; text-decoration: underline; }

.success-step { text-align: center; padding: 20px 0; }
.success-icon {
  width: 60px; height: 60px; border-radius: 50%;
  background: var(--accent-dim);
  color: var(--accent);
  display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
  margin: 0 auto 20px;
}
.success-step h3 { font-size: 21px; }

/* ============ Section head (shared) ============ */
.section-head { max-width: 620px; margin: 0 auto 52px; text-align: center; }
.section-head h2 { font-size: clamp(26px, 3.4vw, 36px); }
.section-head p { font-size: 16px; }

/* ============ Process ============ */
.process { padding: 96px 0; }
.process-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr); gap: 28px; }
.process-card {
  background: linear-gradient(160deg, #F0FBF7, #E4F5EE);
  border: 1px solid rgba(0, 168, 138, 0.16);
  border-radius: var(--radius-md);
  padding: 32px 26px;
  position: relative;
  box-shadow: 0 14px 30px -20px rgba(0, 168, 138, 0.35);
  transition: transform 0.2s ease, box-shadow 0.2s ease;
}
.process-card:hover { transform: translateY(-4px); box-shadow: 0 18px 38px -18px rgba(0, 168, 138, 0.4); }
.process-num {
  font-family: var(--font-mono);
  font-weight: 700;
  font-size: 13px;
  color: #fff;
  background: linear-gradient(135deg, #00A88A, #017E56);
  width: 34px;
  height: 34px;
  border-radius: 10px;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  margin-bottom: 16px;
  letter-spacing: 0.02em;
}
.process-card h3 { font-size: 18px; }
.process-card p { font-size: 14.5px; margin-bottom: 0; }

/* ============ Services ============ */
.services { padding: 96px 0; }
.services-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; gap: 26px; margin-bottom: 60px; }
.service-card {
  background: linear-gradient(180deg, var(--bg-card), var(--bg-alt));
  border: 1px solid var(--border-strong);
  border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
  padding: 34px;
}
.service-icon {
  width: 52px; height: 52px;
  border-radius: 14px;
  background: var(--accent-dim);
  color: var(--accent);
  display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
  margin-bottom: 20px;
}
.service-card h3 { font-size: 21px; }
.tag-row { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 8px; margin-bottom: 26px; }
.tag-row span {
  font-family: var(--font-mono);
  font-size: 12px;
  color: var(--text-muted);
  border: 1px solid var(--border-strong);
  padding: 5px 12px;
  border-radius: 100px;
}
.service-actions { display: flex; gap: 12px; }

.stats-bar {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(4, 1fr);
  width: 100%;
  background: var(--navy);
  border-radius: 0;
  padding: 56px 24px;

.reveal {

<script>
// ===== Multi-step quote form (only present on the homepage) =====
const form = document.getElementById('quoteForm');

if (form) {
  const steps = Array.from(form.querySelectorAll('.form-step'));
  const stepLabel = document.getElementById('stepLabel');
  const progressFill = document.getElementById('progressFill');

  let currentStep = 1;
  const totalSteps = 3;

  const showStep = (stepNumber) => {
    steps.forEach(step => {
      step.classList.toggle('active', step.dataset.step == stepNumber);
    });
    if (stepNumber !== 'success') {
      stepLabel.textContent = `Step ${stepNumber} of ${totalSteps}`;
      progressFill.style.width = `${(stepNumber / totalSteps) * 100}%`;
    }
  };

  form.querySelectorAll('.next-step').forEach(btn => {
    btn.addEventListener('click', () => {
      const activeStep = form.querySelector('.form-step.active');
      const requiredFields = activeStep.querySelectorAll('[required]');
      let valid = true;
      requiredFields.forEach(field => {
        if (!field.value.trim()) {
          valid = false;
          field.style.borderColor = '#FF6B6B';
        } else {
          field.style.borderColor = '';
        }
      });
      if (!valid) return;

      if (currentStep < totalSteps) {
        currentStep++;
        showStep(currentStep);
      }
    });
  });

  form.querySelectorAll('.prev-step').forEach(btn => {
    btn.addEventListener('click', () => {
      if (currentStep > 1) {
        currentStep--;
        showStep(currentStep);
      }
    });
  });

  form.querySelectorAll('.choice-card').forEach(card => {
    card.addEventListener('click', () => {
      form.querySelectorAll('.choice-card').forEach(c => c.classList.remove('selected'));
      card.classList.add('selected');
    });
  });

  form.addEventListener('submit', (e) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    const nameField = form.querySelector('[name="name"]');
    const phoneField = form.querySelector('[name="phone"]');

    if (!nameField.value.trim() || !phoneField.value.trim()) {
      nameField.style.borderColor = nameField.value.trim() ? '' : '#FF6B6B';
      phoneField.style.borderColor = phoneField.value.trim() ? '' : '#FF6B6B';
      return;
    }

    const submitBtn = form.querySelector('button[type="submit"]');
    if (submitBtn) submitBtn.disabled = true;

    fetch(form.action, {
      method: 'POST',
      body: new FormData(form),
      headers: { 'Accept': 'application/json' }
    }).finally(() => {
      document.getElementById('successName').textContent = nameField.value.trim().split(' ')[0];
      document.getElementById('successPhone').textContent = phoneField.value.trim();
      showStep('success');
      if (submitBtn) submitBtn.disabled = false;
    });
  });
}

// ===== Mobile nav toggle =====
const menuToggle = document.getElementById('menuToggle');
const mainNav = document.getElementById('mainNav');
if (menuToggle) {
  menuToggle.addEventListener('click', () => {

}

}

// ENHANCEMENT PASS — scroll reveal on cards/sections
// ============================================
(function () {
  var revealSelectors = '.process-card, .service-card, .why-card, .hub-card, .benefit-card, .related-card, .contact-card, .section-head, .stats-bar, .mini-stats, .timeline-item, .pull-quote';
  var els = document.querySelectorAll(revealSelectors);
  els.forEach(function (el, i) {
    el.classList.add('reveal');
    el.style.transitionDelay = (Math.min(i % 6, 5) * 0.07) + 's';
  });
  if ('IntersectionObserver' in window) {
    var obs = new IntersectionObserver(function (entries) {
      entries.forEach(function (entry) {
        if (entry.isIntersecting) {
          entry.target.classList.add('visible');
          obs.unobserve(entry.target);
        }
      });
    }, { threshold: 0.12, rootMargin: '0px 0px -40px 0px' });
    els.forEach(function (el) { obs.observe(el); });
  } else {
    els.forEach(function (el) { el.classList.add('visible'); });
  }
})();


// ============================================
// ENHANCEMENT PASS — animated count-up for stat numbers
// (works with "2.3M+", "50", "17+", "100%" style values)
// ============================================
(function () {
  function animateCount(el) {
    var raw = el.textContent.trim();
    var match = raw.match(/^([0-9]+(?:\.[0-9]+)?)(.*)$/);
    if (!match) return;
    var target = parseFloat(match[1]);
    var suffix = match[2] || '';
    var isDecimal = match[1].indexOf('.') !== -1;
    var duration = 1400;
    var startTime = null;
    function step(ts) {
      if (!startTime) startTime = ts;
      var progress = Math.min((ts - startTime) / duration, 1);
      var eased = 1 - Math.pow(1 - progress, 3);
      var current = target * eased;
      el.textContent = (isDecimal ? current.toFixed(1) : Math.round(current)) + suffix;
      if (progress < 1) {
        requestAnimationFrame(step);
      } else {
        el.textContent = raw;
      }
    }
    requestAnimationFrame(step);
  }

  var counters = document.querySelectorAll('.stat strong, .mini-stats strong');
  if (!counters.length) return;

  if ('IntersectionObserver' in window) {
    var countObs = new IntersectionObserver(function (entries) {
      entries.forEach(function (entry) {
        if (entry.isIntersecting) {
          animateCount(entry.target);
          countObs.unobserve(entry.target);
        }
      });
    }, { threshold: 0.4 });
    counters.forEach(function (el) { countObs.observe(el); });
  }
})();

</script>

.dropdown.two-col { min-width: 380px; display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; }
.nav-item:hover .dropdown { opacity: 1; visibility: visible; transform: translateY(0); }
.dropdown a {
  padding: 8px 12px;
  border-radius: 6px;
  font-size: 14px;
  color: var(--text-muted);
}
.dropdown a:hover { background: var(--accent-dim); color: var(--accent); }

.header-actions { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; }
.phone-pill {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 8px;
  font-family: var(--font-mono);
  font-size: 13.5px;
  color: var(--text);
  border: 1px solid var(--border-strong);
  padding: 9px 16px;
  border-radius: 100px;
}
.phone-pill svg { color: var(--warm); }
.phone-pill:hover { border-color: var(--warm); }

.menu-toggle {
  display: none;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 5px;
  background: none;
  border: none;
  cursor: pointer;
  padding: 6px;
}
.menu-toggle span { width: 22px; height: 2px; background: var(--text); border-radius: 2px; }

/* ============ Hero ============ */
.hero {
  position: relative;
  padding: 96px 0;
  overflow: hidden;
}
.hero-bg {
  position: absolute;
  inset: 0;
  z-index: 0;
  background:
    radial-gradient(ellipse 700px 500px at 85% 10%, rgba(0, 229, 180, 0.14), transparent 60%),
    radial-gradient(ellipse 600px 400px at 5% 90%, rgba(255, 159, 91, 0.08), transparent 60%);
}
.signal-lines {
  position: absolute;
  inset: 0;
  display: flex;
  align-items: flex-end;
  justify-content: space-evenly;
  opacity: 0.35;
  padding-bottom: 0;
}
.signal-lines span {
  width: 1px;
  background: linear-gradient(to top, var(--accent), transparent);
  height: 20%;
  animation: signalPulse 3.4s ease-in-out infinite;
}
.signal-lines span:nth-child(1) { animation-delay: 0s; height: 30%; }
.signal-lines span:nth-child(2) { animation-delay: 0.3s; height: 55%; }
.signal-lines span:nth-child(3) { animation-delay: 0.6s; height: 20%; }
.signal-lines span:nth-child(4) { animation-delay: 0.9s; height: 70%; }
.signal-lines span:nth-child(5) { animation-delay: 1.2s; height: 40%; }
.signal-lines span:nth-child(6) { animation-delay: 1.5s; height: 60%; }
.signal-lines span:nth-child(7) { animation-delay: 1.8s; height: 25%; }
@keyframes signalPulse {
  0%, 100% { transform: scaleY(0.6); opacity: 0.3; }
  50% { transform: scaleY(1); opacity: 0.7; }
}

.hero-inner {
  position: relative;
  z-index: 1;
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: 1.1fr 0.9fr;
  gap: 60px;
  align-items: center;
}
.hero-copy h1 {
  font-size: clamp(32px, 4vw, 50px);
  max-width: 620px;
}
.hero-sub { font-size: 17px; max-width: 520px; }
.hero-cta-row { display: flex; gap: 14px; flex-wrap: wrap; margin: 28px 0 30px; }
.hero-cta-row.center { justify-content: center; }

.trust-badges {
  list-style: none;
  padding: 0;
  margin: 0;
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: nowrap;
  gap: 20px;
}
.trust-badges li {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 8px;
  font-size: 13px;
  color: var(--text-muted);
  font-weight: 500;
  white-space: nowrap;
}
.trust-badges .check {
  width: 18px;
  height: 18px;
  border-radius: 50%;
  flex-shrink: 0;
  background: var(--accent-dim);
  border: 1px solid var(--accent);
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
}
.trust-badges .check svg { color: var(--accent); display: block; }
@media (max-width: 640px) {
  .trust-badges { flex-wrap: wrap; }
  .trust-badges li { white-space: normal; }
}

/* --- Signature: connecting call card --- */
.hero-visual { display: flex; justify-content: center; }
.call-card {
  width: 100%;
  max-width: 340px;
  background: linear-gradient(180deg, var(--bg-card), var(--bg-alt));
  border: 1px solid var(--border-strong);
  border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
  padding: 28px 26px 24px;
  box-shadow: var(--shadow-lg);
}
.call-card-top {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 8px;
  font-family: var(--font-mono);
  font-size: 12.5px;
  color: var(--text-muted);
  margin-bottom: 26px;
}
.dot {
  width: 7px; height: 7px; border-radius: 50%;
  background: var(--accent);
  box-shadow: 0 0 0 0 rgba(0,229,180,0.6);
  animation: dotPulse 1.6s infinite;
}
@keyframes dotPulse {
  0% { box-shadow: 0 0 0 0 rgba(0,229,180,0.55); }
  70% { box-shadow: 0 0 0 8px rgba(0,229,180,0); }
  100% { box-shadow: 0 0 0 0 rgba(0,229,180,0); }
}

.ring-wrap {
  position: relative;
  width: 120px;
  height: 120px;
  margin: 0 auto 24px;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
}
.ring {
  position: absolute;
  border-radius: 50%;
  border: 1.5px solid var(--accent);
  opacity: 0;
  animation: ringExpand 2.4s ease-out infinite;
}
.ring.r1 { width: 60px; height: 60px; animation-delay: 0s; }
.ring.r2 { width: 60px; height: 60px; animation-delay: 0.8s; }
.ring.r3 { width: 60px; height: 60px; animation-delay: 1.6s; }
@keyframes ringExpand {
  0% { width: 60px; height: 60px; opacity: 0.7; }
  100% { width: 120px; height: 120px; opacity: 0; }
}
.ring-core {
  position: relative;
  z-index: 1;
  width: 60px;
  height: 60px;
  border-radius: 50%;
  background: var(--accent);
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  box-shadow: 0 0 30px rgba(0, 229, 180, 0.5);
}

.wave { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 3px; height: 32px; margin-bottom: 22px; }
.wave span {
  width: 3px;
  background: var(--text-dim);
  border-radius: 2px;
  animation: waveMove 1.2s ease-in-out infinite;
}
.wave span:nth-child(odd) { background: var(--accent); opacity: 0.7; }
.wave span:nth-child(1) { height: 30%; animation-delay: 0s; }
.wave span:nth-child(2) { height: 60%; animation-delay: 0.1s; }
.wave span:nth-child(3) { height: 90%; animation-delay: 0.2s; }
.wave span:nth-child(4) { height: 45%; animation-delay: 0.3s; }
.wave span:nth-child(5) { height: 70%; animation-delay: 0.4s; }
.wave span:nth-child(6) { height: 100%; animation-delay: 0.5s; }
.wave span:nth-child(7) { height: 55%; animation-delay: 0.6s; }
.wave span:nth-child(8) { height: 80%; animation-delay: 0.7s; }
.wave span:nth-child(9) { height: 40%; animation-delay: 0.8s; }
.wave span:nth-child(10) { height: 65%; animation-delay: 0.9s; }
.wave span:nth-child(11) { height: 35%; animation-delay: 1s; }
.wave span:nth-child(12) { height: 55%; animation-delay: 1.1s; }
@keyframes waveMove {
  0%, 100% { transform: scaleY(0.5); }
  50% { transform: scaleY(1); }
}

.call-card-bottom { border-top: 1px solid var(--border); padding-top: 16px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 10px; }
.match-row { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; font-size: 13px; font-family: var(--font-mono); }
.match-row .label { color: var(--text-dim); }
.match-row .value { color: var(--text); }
.match-row .value.accent { color: var(--accent); }

/* ============ Quote form ============ */
.quote-section { padding: 96px 0; background: var(--bg-alt); border-top: 1px solid var(--border); border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border); }
.quote-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 0.9fr 1.1fr; gap: 70px; align-items: start; }
.quote-intro h2 { font-size: clamp(26px, 3vw, 34px); }
.mini-stats { display: flex; gap: 34px; margin-top: 32px; }
.mini-stats strong { display: block; font-family: var(--font-display); font-size: 24px; color: var(--accent); }
.mini-stats span { font-size: 12.5px; color: var(--text-muted); font-family: var(--font-mono); }

.quote-form {
  background: var(--bg-card);
  border: 1px solid var(--border-strong);
  border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
  padding: 34px;
  box-shadow: var(--shadow-lg);
}
.form-progress { margin-bottom: 26px; }
.step-label { font-family: var(--font-mono); font-size: 12px; color: var(--accent); letter-spacing: 0.04em; text-transform: uppercase; }
.progress-track { height: 4px; background: var(--border); border-radius: 4px; margin-top: 10px; overflow: hidden; }
.progress-fill { height: 100%; width: 33.3%; background: var(--accent); border-radius: 4px; transition: width 0.35s ease; }

.form-step { display: none; }
.form-step.active { display: block; animation: stepIn 0.3s ease; }
@keyframes stepIn { from { opacity: 0; transform: translateX(8px); } to { opacity: 1; transform: translateX(0); } }
.form-step h3 { font-size: 19px; margin-bottom: 20px; }

.choice-row { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; gap: 12px; margin-bottom: 20px; }
.choice-card {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 8px;
  padding: 20px 12px;
  background: var(--bg-alt);
  border: 1px solid var(--border-strong);
  border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
  color: var(--text-muted);
  font-family: var(--font-body);
  font-weight: 600;
  font-size: 14px;
  cursor: pointer;
  transition: all 0.15s ease;
}
.choice-card svg { color: var(--text-muted); transition: color 0.15s ease; }
.choice-card:hover { border-color: var(--border-strong); }
.choice-card.selected { border-color: var(--accent); background: var(--accent-dim); color: var(--accent); }
.choice-card.selected svg { color: var(--accent); }

.field { display: block; margin-bottom: 18px; }
.field span { display: block; font-size: 13px; color: var(--text-muted); margin-bottom: 8px; font-weight: 500; }
.field input, .field select {
  width: 100%;
  background: var(--bg-alt);
  border: 1px solid var(--border-strong);
  color: var(--text);
  font-family: var(--font-body);
  font-size: 14.5px;
  padding: 12px 14px;
  border-radius: 10px;
  transition: border-color 0.15s ease;
}
.field input:focus, .field select:focus { border-color: var(--accent); outline: none; }
.field input::placeholder { color: var(--text-dim); }

.form-nav { display: flex; gap: 12px; margin-top: 8px; }
.form-nav .btn-ghost { flex: 0 0 auto; }
.form-nav .btn-accent { flex: 1; }

.fine-print { font-size: 12px; color: var(--text-dim); margin: 4px 0 18px; }
.fine-print a { color: var(--accent); font-weight: 600; text-decoration: underline; }

.success-step { text-align: center; padding: 20px 0; }
.success-icon {
  width: 60px; height: 60px; border-radius: 50%;
  background: var(--accent-dim);
  color: var(--accent);
  display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
  margin: 0 auto 20px;
}
.success-step h3 { font-size: 21px; }

/* ============ Section head (shared) ============ */
.section-head { max-width: 620px; margin: 0 auto 52px; text-align: center; }
.section-head h2 { font-size: clamp(26px, 3.4vw, 36px); }
.section-head p { font-size: 16px; }

/* ============ Process ============ */
.process { padding: 96px 0; }
.process-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr); gap: 28px; }
.process-card {
  background: linear-gradient(160deg, #F0FBF7, #E4F5EE);
  border: 1px solid rgba(0, 168, 138, 0.16);
  border-radius: var(--radius-md);
  padding: 32px 26px;
  position: relative;
  box-shadow: 0 14px 30px -20px rgba(0, 168, 138, 0.35);
  transition: transform 0.2s ease, box-shadow 0.2s ease;
}
.process-card:hover { transform: translateY(-4px); box-shadow: 0 18px 38px -18px rgba(0, 168, 138, 0.4); }
.process-num {
  font-family: var(--font-mono);
  font-weight: 700;
  font-size: 13px;
  color: #fff;
  background: linear-gradient(135deg, #00A88A, #017E56);
  width: 34px;
  height: 34px;
  border-radius: 10px;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  margin-bottom: 16px;
  letter-spacing: 0.02em;
}
.process-card h3 { font-size: 18px; }
.process-card p { font-size: 14.5px; margin-bottom: 0; }

/* ============ Services ============ */
.services { padding: 96px 0; }
.services-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; gap: 26px; margin-bottom: 60px; }
.service-card {
  background: linear-gradient(180deg, var(--bg-card), var(--bg-alt));
  border: 1px solid var(--border-strong);
  border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
  padding: 34px;
}
.service-icon {
  width: 52px; height: 52px;
  border-radius: 14px;
  background: var(--accent-dim);
  color: var(--accent);
  display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
  margin-bottom: 20px;
}
.service-card h3 { font-size: 21px; }
.tag-row { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 8px; margin-bottom: 26px; }
.tag-row span {
  font-family: var(--font-mono);
  font-size: 12px;
  color: var(--text-muted);
  border: 1px solid var(--border-strong);
  padding: 5px 12px;
  border-radius: 100px;
}
.service-actions { display: flex; gap: 12px; }

.stats-bar {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr);
  gap: 24px;
  background: linear-gradient(135deg, #013A28, #017E56);
  border: none;
  border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
  padding: 40px 20px;
  max-width: 760px;
  margin: 0 auto;
  box-shadow: 0 20px 44px -22px rgba(1, 126, 86, 0.5);
}
.stat { text-align: center; }
.stat strong { display: block; font-family: var(--font-display); font-size: 32px; color: #6FFFD4; margin-bottom: 4px; }
.stat span { font-size: 12.5px; color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.75); font-family: var(--font-mono); }

/* ============ Why us ============ */
.why { padding: 96px 0; }
.why-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr); gap: 24px; }
.why-card {
  border-radius: var(--radius-md);
  padding: 28px 24px;
  box-shadow: 0 10px 26px -18px rgba(16, 19, 31, 0.25);
  transition: transform 0.2s ease, box-shadow 0.2s ease;
}
.why-card:hover { transform: translateY(-4px); box-shadow: 0 18px 36px -18px rgba(16, 19, 31, 0.3); }
.why-card .icon-badge {
  width: 44px;
  height: 44px;
  border-radius: 12px;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  margin-bottom: 16px;
}
.why-card:nth-child(1) { background: #EDFCF7; border: 1px solid #BFEFDF; }
.why-card:nth-child(2) { background: #EFF5FF; border: 1px solid #C6DBFF; }
.why-card:nth-child(3) { background: #FFF7EA; border: 1px solid #FBE3B8; }
.why-card:nth-child(4) { background: #FEF0F6; border: 1px solid #FAD0E4; }
.why-card:nth-child(5) { background: #F5F0FF; border: 1px solid #DBCBFC; }
.why-card:nth-child(6) { background: #EAFAFC; border: 1px solid #BEEAF0; }
.why-card:nth-child(1) .icon-badge { background: #CFF5E7; color: #00A88A; }
.why-card:nth-child(2) .icon-badge { background: #D6E6FF; color: #2E6FE8; }
.why-card:nth-child(3) .icon-badge { background: #FCE7C2; color: #B96E00; }
.why-card:nth-child(4) .icon-badge { background: #FCDAEA; color: #D6417B; }
.why-card:nth-child(5) .icon-badge { background: #E4D8FF; color: #7C4DE0; }
.why-card:nth-child(6) .icon-badge { background: #CDF1F6; color: #0EA5C4; }
.why-card h3 { font-size: 17px; }
.why-card p { font-size: 14px; margin-bottom: 0; }

/* ============ Final CTA ============ */
.final-cta {
  padding: 96px 0;
  background: #9FE8CE;
  border-top: 1px solid rgba(16, 19, 31, 0.12);
  text-align: center;
}
.final-cta-inner h2 { font-size: clamp(26px, 3.4vw, 38px); }
.final-cta-inner p { max-width: 480px; margin: 0 auto 8px; }

/* ============ Footer ============ */
.site-footer { padding: 70px 0 30px; background: var(--navy-card); border-top: 1px solid var(--navy-border-strong); position: relative; }
.site-footer::before { content: ""; position: absolute; top: -1px; left: 0; right: 0; height: 2px; background: linear-gradient(90deg, transparent, var(--navy-accent), transparent); opacity: 0.6; }
.footer-grid {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: 1.4fr 1fr 1fr 1fr;
  gap: 40px;
  padding-bottom: 50px;
}
.footer-brand p { font-size: 13.5px; margin: 14px 0 16px; max-width: 280px; }
.footer-phone { font-family: var(--font-mono); color: var(--accent); font-size: 14px; }
.footer-col h4 { font-family: var(--font-body); font-size: 13px; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.05em; color: var(--accent); margin-bottom: 16px; }
.footer-col a { display: block; font-size: 14px; color: rgba(244, 246, 251, 0.8); margin-bottom: 11px; }
.footer-col a:hover { color: var(--accent); }
.footer-bottom {
  border-top: 1px solid var(--border);
  padding-top: 24px;
  font-size: 13px;
  color: rgba(244, 246, 251, 0.75);
  display: flex;
  justify-content: space-between;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  gap: 10px;
}
.footer-bottom a { color: rgba(244, 246, 251, 0.75); }
.footer-bottom a:hover { color: var(--accent); }

/* ============ Inner pages: breadcrumb + hero banner ============ */
.breadcrumb {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 8px;
  font-family: var(--font-mono);
  font-size: 12.5px;
  color: var(--text-dim);
  margin-bottom: 22px;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
}
.breadcrumb a { color: var(--text-muted); }
.breadcrumb a:hover { color: var(--accent); }
.breadcrumb .sep { opacity: 0.5; }
.breadcrumb .current { color: var(--text); }

.inner-hero {
  padding: 72px 0;
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--navy-border);
  text-align: center;
}
.inner-hero .container { display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; }
.inner-hero h1 { font-size: clamp(30px, 4vw, 44px); max-width: 700px; }
.inner-hero p { max-width: 560px; font-size: 16.5px; }
.inner-hero .hero-cta-row { margin: 26px 0 6px; justify-content: center; }

/* ============ Content sections (inner pages) ============ */
.content-section { padding: 96px 0; }
.content-section.tight { padding: 64px 0; }
.content-columns {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: 1.1fr 0.9fr;
  gap: 56px;
  align-items: start;
}
.content-columns h2 { font-size: clamp(24px, 3vw, 30px); }
.content-columns p { font-size: 15.5px; }

.benefit-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; gap: 16px; }
.benefit-card {
  display: flex;
  gap: 12px;
  align-items: flex-start;
  background: var(--bg-card);
  border: 1px solid var(--border);
  border-radius: var(--radius-md);
  padding: 20px 18px;
}
.benefit-card svg { color: var(--accent); flex-shrink: 0; margin-top: 2px; }
.benefit-card p { margin: 0; font-size: 14.5px; color: var(--text); }

/* ============ Hub pages (Insurance / Home Services listing) ============ */
.hub-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr); gap: 22px; }
.hub-card {
  display: block;
  background: var(--bg-card);
  border: 1px solid var(--border);
  border-radius: var(--radius-md);
  padding: 26px 22px;
  transition: border-color 0.15s ease, transform 0.15s ease;
}
.hub-card:hover { border-color: var(--accent); transform: translateY(-2px); }
.hub-card .service-icon { width: 44px; height: 44px; margin-bottom: 16px; }
.hub-card h3 { font-size: 16.5px; margin-bottom: 6px; }
.hub-card p { font-size: 13.5px; margin-bottom: 0; }
.hub-card .go-link { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; margin-top: 14px; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 600; color: var(--accent); }

/* ============ Related services (bottom of detail pages) ============ */
.related-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(4, 1fr); gap: 14px; }
.related-card {
  display: block;
  text-align: center;
  background: var(--bg-card);
  border: 1px solid var(--border);
  border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
  padding: 18px 12px;
  font-size: 13.5px;
  font-weight: 600;
  color: var(--text-muted);
}
.related-card:hover { border-color: var(--accent); color: var(--accent); }

/* ============ Contact page ============ */
.contact-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 0.9fr 1.1fr; gap: 56px; align-items: start; }
.contact-card {
  background: var(--bg-card);
  border: 1px solid var(--border);
  border-radius: var(--radius-md);
  padding: 24px 22px;
  margin-bottom: 14px;
}
.contact-card h4 { font-family: var(--font-body); font-size: 13px; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.05em; color: var(--text-dim); margin-bottom: 10px; }
.contact-card .value { font-family: var(--font-mono); font-size: 16px; color: var(--text); }
.contact-form {
  background: var(--bg-card);
  border: 1px solid var(--border);
  border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
  padding: 32px;
}
.contact-form .field-row { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; gap: 16px; }

/* ============ Legal pages ============ */
.legal-content { max-width: 760px; }
.legal-content h2 { font-size: 20px; margin-top: 40px; }

<script>
// ===== Multi-step quote form (only present on the homepage) =====
const form = document.getElementById('quoteForm');

if (form) {
  const steps = Array.from(form.querySelectorAll('.form-step'));
  const stepLabel = document.getElementById('stepLabel');
  const progressFill = document.getElementById('progressFill');

  let currentStep = 1;
  const totalSteps = 3;

  const showStep = (stepNumber) => {
    steps.forEach(step => {
      step.classList.toggle('active', step.dataset.step == stepNumber);
    });
    if (stepNumber !== 'success') {
      stepLabel.textContent = `Step ${stepNumber} of ${totalSteps}`;
      progressFill.style.width = `${(stepNumber / totalSteps) * 100}%`;
    }
  };

  form.querySelectorAll('.next-step').forEach(btn => {
    btn.addEventListener('click', () => {
      const activeStep = form.querySelector('.form-step.active');
      const requiredFields = activeStep.querySelectorAll('[required]');
      let valid = true;
      requiredFields.forEach(field => {
        if (!field.value.trim()) {
          valid = false;
          field.style.borderColor = '#FF6B6B';
        } else {
          field.style.borderColor = '';
        }
      });
      if (!valid) return;

      if (currentStep < totalSteps) {
        currentStep++;
        showStep(currentStep);
      }
    });
  });

  form.querySelectorAll('.prev-step').forEach(btn => {
    btn.addEventListener('click', () => {
      if (currentStep > 1) {
        currentStep--;
        showStep(currentStep);
      }
    });
  });

  form.querySelectorAll('.choice-card').forEach(card => {
    card.addEventListener('click', () => {
      form.querySelectorAll('.choice-card').forEach(c => c.classList.remove('selected'));
      card.classList.add('selected');
    });
  });

  form.addEventListener('submit', (e) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    const nameField = form.querySelector('[name="name"]');
    const phoneField = form.querySelector('[name="phone"]');

    if (!nameField.value.trim() || !phoneField.value.trim()) {
      nameField.style.borderColor = nameField.value.trim() ? '' : '#FF6B6B';
      phoneField.style.borderColor = phoneField.value.trim() ? '' : '#FF6B6B';
      return;
    }

    const submitBtn = form.querySelector('button[type="submit"]');
    if (submitBtn) submitBtn.disabled = true;

    fetch(form.action, {
      method: 'POST',
      body: new FormData(form),
      headers: { 'Accept': 'application/json' }
    }).finally(() => {
      document.getElementById('successName').textContent = nameField.value.trim().split(' ')[0];
      document.getElementById('successPhone').textContent = phoneField.value.trim();
      showStep('success');
      if (submitBtn) submitBtn.disabled = false;
    });
  });
}

// ===== Mobile nav toggle =====
const menuToggle = document.getElementById('menuToggle');
const mainNav = document.getElementById('mainNav');
if (menuToggle) {

    mainNav.classList.toggle('open');
  });
}

// ===== Header CTA scrolls to quote form =====
const openQuoteBtn = document.getElementById('openQuoteBtn');
if (openQuoteBtn) {
  openQuoteBtn.addEventListener('click', () => {
    document.getElementById('quote').scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth' });
  });

// ============================================
// ENHANCEMENT PASS — scroll reveal on cards/sections
// ============================================
(function () {
  var revealSelectors = '.process-card, .service-card, .why-card, .hub-card, .benefit-card, .related-card, .contact-card, .section-head, .stats-bar, .mini-stats, .timeline-item, .pull-quote';
  var els = document.querySelectorAll(revealSelectors);
  els.forEach(function (el, i) {
    el.classList.add('reveal');
    el.style.transitionDelay = (Math.min(i % 6, 5) * 0.07) + 's';
  });
  if ('IntersectionObserver' in window) {
    var obs = new IntersectionObserver(function (entries) {
      entries.forEach(function (entry) {
        if (entry.isIntersecting) {
          entry.target.classList.add('visible');
          obs.unobserve(entry.target);
        }
      });
    }, { threshold: 0.12, rootMargin: '0px 0px -40px 0px' });
    els.forEach(function (el) { obs.observe(el); });
  } else {
    els.forEach(function (el) { el.classList.add('visible'); });
  }
})();


// ============================================
// ENHANCEMENT PASS — animated count-up for stat numbers
// (works with "2.3M+", "50", "17+", "100%" style values)
// ============================================
(function () {
  function animateCount(el) {
    var raw = el.textContent.trim();
    var match = raw.match(/^([0-9]+(?:\.[0-9]+)?)(.*)$/);
    if (!match) return;
    var target = parseFloat(match[1]);
    var suffix = match[2] || '';
    var isDecimal = match[1].indexOf('.') !== -1;
    var duration = 1400;
    var startTime = null;
    function step(ts) {
      if (!startTime) startTime = ts;
      var progress = Math.min((ts - startTime) / duration, 1);
      var eased = 1 - Math.pow(1 - progress, 3);
      var current = target * eased;
      el.textContent = (isDecimal ? current.toFixed(1) : Math.round(current)) + suffix;
      if (progress < 1) {
        requestAnimationFrame(step);
      } else {
        el.textContent = raw;
      }
    }
    requestAnimationFrame(step);
  }

  var counters = document.querySelectorAll('.stat strong, .mini-stats strong');
  if (!counters.length) return;

  if ('IntersectionObserver' in window) {
    var countObs = new IntersectionObserver(function (entries) {
      entries.forEach(function (entry) {
        if (entry.isIntersecting) {
          animateCount(entry.target);
          countObs.unobserve(entry.target);
        }
      });
    }, { threshold: 0.4 });
    counters.forEach(function (el) { countObs.observe(el); });
  }
})();

</script>

.content-section { padding: 96px 0; }

<script>
// ===== Multi-step quote form (only present on the homepage) =====
const form = document.getElementById('quoteForm');

if (form) {
  const steps = Array.from(form.querySelectorAll('.form-step'));
  const stepLabel = document.getElementById('stepLabel');
  const progressFill = document.getElementById('progressFill');

  let currentStep = 1;
  const totalSteps = 3;

  const showStep = (stepNumber) => {
    steps.forEach(step => {
      step.classList.toggle('active', step.dataset.step == stepNumber);
    });
    if (stepNumber !== 'success') {
      stepLabel.textContent = `Step ${stepNumber} of ${totalSteps}`;
      progressFill.style.width = `${(stepNumber / totalSteps) * 100}%`;
    }
  };

  form.querySelectorAll('.next-step').forEach(btn => {
    btn.addEventListener('click', () => {
      const activeStep = form.querySelector('.form-step.active');
      const requiredFields = activeStep.querySelectorAll('[required]');
      let valid = true;
      requiredFields.forEach(field => {
        if (!field.value.trim()) {
          valid = false;
          field.style.borderColor = '#FF6B6B';
        } else {
          field.style.borderColor = '';
        }
      });
      if (!valid) return;

      if (currentStep < totalSteps) {
        currentStep++;
        showStep(currentStep);
      }
    });
  });

  form.querySelectorAll('.prev-step').forEach(btn => {
    btn.addEventListener('click', () => {
      if (currentStep > 1) {
        currentStep--;
        showStep(currentStep);
      }
    });
  });

  form.querySelectorAll('.choice-card').forEach(card => {
    card.addEventListener('click', () => {
      form.querySelectorAll('.choice-card').forEach(c => c.classList.remove('selected'));
      card.classList.add('selected');
    });
  });

  form.addEventListener('submit', (e) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    const nameField = form.querySelector('[name="name"]');
    const phoneField = form.querySelector('[name="phone"]');

    if (!nameField.value.trim() || !phoneField.value.trim()) {
      nameField.style.borderColor = nameField.value.trim() ? '' : '#FF6B6B';
      phoneField.style.borderColor = phoneField.value.trim() ? '' : '#FF6B6B';
      return;
    }

    const submitBtn = form.querySelector('button[type="submit"]');
    if (submitBtn) submitBtn.disabled = true;

    fetch(form.action, {
      method: 'POST',
      body: new FormData(form),
      headers: { 'Accept': 'application/json' }
    }).finally(() => {
      document.getElementById('successName').textContent = nameField.value.trim().split(' ')[0];
      document.getElementById('successPhone').textContent = phoneField.value.trim();
      showStep('success');
      if (submitBtn) submitBtn.disabled = false;
    });
  });
}

// ===== Mobile nav toggle =====
const menuToggle = document.getElementById('menuToggle');
const mainNav = document.getElementById('mainNav');
if (menuToggle) {
  menuToggle.addEventListener('click', () => {
    mainNav.classList.toggle('open');

}

  });
}


// ============================================
// ENHANCEMENT PASS — scroll reveal on cards/sections
// ============================================
(function () {
  var revealSelectors = '.process-card, .service-card, .why-card, .hub-card, .benefit-card, .related-card, .contact-card, .section-head, .stats-bar, .mini-stats, .timeline-item, .pull-quote';
  var els = document.querySelectorAll(revealSelectors);
  els.forEach(function (el, i) {
    el.classList.add('reveal');
    el.style.transitionDelay = (Math.min(i % 6, 5) * 0.07) + 's';
  });
  if ('IntersectionObserver' in window) {
    var obs = new IntersectionObserver(function (entries) {
      entries.forEach(function (entry) {
        if (entry.isIntersecting) {
          entry.target.classList.add('visible');
          obs.unobserve(entry.target);
        }
      });
    }, { threshold: 0.12, rootMargin: '0px 0px -40px 0px' });
    els.forEach(function (el) { obs.observe(el); });
  } else {
    els.forEach(function (el) { el.classList.add('visible'); });
  }
})();


// ============================================
// ENHANCEMENT PASS — animated count-up for stat numbers
// (works with "2.3M+", "50", "17+", "100%" style values)
// ============================================
(function () {
  function animateCount(el) {
    var raw = el.textContent.trim();
    var match = raw.match(/^([0-9]+(?:\.[0-9]+)?)(.*)$/);
    if (!match) return;
    var target = parseFloat(match[1]);
    var suffix = match[2] || '';
    var isDecimal = match[1].indexOf('.') !== -1;
    var duration = 1400;
    var startTime = null;
    function step(ts) {
      if (!startTime) startTime = ts;
      var progress = Math.min((ts - startTime) / duration, 1);
      var eased = 1 - Math.pow(1 - progress, 3);
      var current = target * eased;
      el.textContent = (isDecimal ? current.toFixed(1) : Math.round(current)) + suffix;
      if (progress < 1) {
        requestAnimationFrame(step);
      } else {
        el.textContent = raw;
      }
    }
    requestAnimationFrame(step);
  }

  var counters = document.querySelectorAll('.stat strong, .mini-stats strong');
  if (!counters.length) return;

  if ('IntersectionObserver' in window) {
    var countObs = new IntersectionObserver(function (entries) {
      entries.forEach(function (entry) {
        if (entry.isIntersecting) {
          animateCount(entry.target);
          countObs.unobserve(entry.target);
        }
      });
    }, { threshold: 0.4 });
    counters.forEach(function (el) { countObs.observe(el); });
  }
})();

</script>

.nav-item:hover .dropdown { opacity: 1; visibility: visible; transform: translateY(0); }
.dropdown a {
  padding: 8px 12px;
  border-radius: 6px;
  font-size: 14px;
  color: var(--text-muted);
}
.dropdown a:hover { background: var(--accent-dim); color: var(--accent); }

.header-actions { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; }
.phone-pill {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 8px;
  font-family: var(--font-mono);
  font-size: 13.5px;
  color: var(--text);
  border: 1px solid var(--border-strong);
  padding: 9px 16px;
  border-radius: 100px;
}
.phone-pill svg { color: var(--warm); }
.phone-pill:hover { border-color: var(--warm); }

.menu-toggle {
  display: none;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 5px;
  background: none;
  border: none;
  cursor: pointer;
  padding: 6px;
}
.menu-toggle span { width: 22px; height: 2px; background: var(--text); border-radius: 2px; }

/* ============ Hero ============ */
.hero {
  position: relative;
  padding: 96px 0;
  overflow: hidden;
}
.hero-bg {
  position: absolute;
  inset: 0;
  z-index: 0;
  background:
    radial-gradient(ellipse 700px 500px at 85% 10%, rgba(0, 229, 180, 0.14), transparent 60%),
    radial-gradient(ellipse 600px 400px at 5% 90%, rgba(255, 159, 91, 0.08), transparent 60%);
}
.signal-lines {
  position: absolute;
  inset: 0;
  display: flex;
  align-items: flex-end;
  justify-content: space-evenly;
  opacity: 0.35;
  padding-bottom: 0;
}
.signal-lines span {
  width: 1px;
  background: linear-gradient(to top, var(--accent), transparent);
  height: 20%;
  animation: signalPulse 3.4s ease-in-out infinite;
}
.signal-lines span:nth-child(1) { animation-delay: 0s; height: 30%; }
.signal-lines span:nth-child(2) { animation-delay: 0.3s; height: 55%; }
.signal-lines span:nth-child(3) { animation-delay: 0.6s; height: 20%; }
.signal-lines span:nth-child(4) { animation-delay: 0.9s; height: 70%; }
.signal-lines span:nth-child(5) { animation-delay: 1.2s; height: 40%; }
.signal-lines span:nth-child(6) { animation-delay: 1.5s; height: 60%; }
.signal-lines span:nth-child(7) { animation-delay: 1.8s; height: 25%; }
@keyframes signalPulse {
  0%, 100% { transform: scaleY(0.6); opacity: 0.3; }
  50% { transform: scaleY(1); opacity: 0.7; }
}

.hero-inner {
  position: relative;
  z-index: 1;
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: 1.1fr 0.9fr;
  gap: 60px;
  align-items: center;
}
.hero-copy h1 {
  font-size: clamp(32px, 4vw, 50px);
  max-width: 620px;
}
.hero-sub { font-size: 17px; max-width: 520px; }
.hero-cta-row { display: flex; gap: 14px; flex-wrap: wrap; margin: 28px 0 30px; }
.hero-cta-row.center { justify-content: center; }

.trust-badges {
  list-style: none;
  padding: 0;
  margin: 0;
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: nowrap;
  gap: 20px;
}
.trust-badges li {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 8px;
  font-size: 13px;
  color: var(--text-muted);
  font-weight: 500;
  white-space: nowrap;
}
.trust-badges .check {
  width: 18px;
  height: 18px;
  border-radius: 50%;
  flex-shrink: 0;
  background: var(--accent-dim);
  border: 1px solid var(--accent);
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
}
.trust-badges .check svg { color: var(--accent); display: block; }
@media (max-width: 640px) {
  .trust-badges { flex-wrap: wrap; }
  .trust-badges li { white-space: normal; }
}

/* --- Signature: connecting call card --- */
.hero-visual { display: flex; justify-content: center; }
.call-card {
  width: 100%;
  max-width: 340px;
  background: linear-gradient(180deg, var(--bg-card), var(--bg-alt));
  border: 1px solid var(--border-strong);
  border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
  padding: 28px 26px 24px;
  box-shadow: var(--shadow-lg);
}
.call-card-top {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 8px;
  font-family: var(--font-mono);
  font-size: 12.5px;
  color: var(--text-muted);
  margin-bottom: 26px;
}
.dot {
  width: 7px; height: 7px; border-radius: 50%;
  background: var(--accent);
  box-shadow: 0 0 0 0 rgba(0,229,180,0.6);
  animation: dotPulse 1.6s infinite;
}
@keyframes dotPulse {
  0% { box-shadow: 0 0 0 0 rgba(0,229,180,0.55); }
  70% { box-shadow: 0 0 0 8px rgba(0,229,180,0); }
  100% { box-shadow: 0 0 0 0 rgba(0,229,180,0); }
}

.ring-wrap {
  position: relative;
  width: 120px;
  height: 120px;
  margin: 0 auto 24px;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
}
.ring {
  position: absolute;
  border-radius: 50%;
  border: 1.5px solid var(--accent);
  opacity: 0;
  animation: ringExpand 2.4s ease-out infinite;
}
.ring.r1 { width: 60px; height: 60px; animation-delay: 0s; }
.ring.r2 { width: 60px; height: 60px; animation-delay: 0.8s; }
.ring.r3 { width: 60px; height: 60px; animation-delay: 1.6s; }
@keyframes ringExpand {
  0% { width: 60px; height: 60px; opacity: 0.7; }
  100% { width: 120px; height: 120px; opacity: 0; }
}
.ring-core {
  position: relative;
  z-index: 1;
  width: 60px;
  height: 60px;
  border-radius: 50%;
  background: var(--accent);
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  box-shadow: 0 0 30px rgba(0, 229, 180, 0.5);
}

.wave { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 3px; height: 32px; margin-bottom: 22px; }
.wave span {
  width: 3px;
  background: var(--text-dim);
  border-radius: 2px;
  animation: waveMove 1.2s ease-in-out infinite;
}
.wave span:nth-child(odd) { background: var(--accent); opacity: 0.7; }
.wave span:nth-child(1) { height: 30%; animation-delay: 0s; }
.wave span:nth-child(2) { height: 60%; animation-delay: 0.1s; }
.wave span:nth-child(3) { height: 90%; animation-delay: 0.2s; }
.wave span:nth-child(4) { height: 45%; animation-delay: 0.3s; }
.wave span:nth-child(5) { height: 70%; animation-delay: 0.4s; }
.wave span:nth-child(6) { height: 100%; animation-delay: 0.5s; }
.wave span:nth-child(7) { height: 55%; animation-delay: 0.6s; }
.wave span:nth-child(8) { height: 80%; animation-delay: 0.7s; }
.wave span:nth-child(9) { height: 40%; animation-delay: 0.8s; }
.wave span:nth-child(10) { height: 65%; animation-delay: 0.9s; }
.wave span:nth-child(11) { height: 35%; animation-delay: 1s; }
.wave span:nth-child(12) { height: 55%; animation-delay: 1.1s; }
@keyframes waveMove {
  0%, 100% { transform: scaleY(0.5); }
  50% { transform: scaleY(1); }
}

.call-card-bottom { border-top: 1px solid var(--border); padding-top: 16px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 10px; }
.match-row { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; font-size: 13px; font-family: var(--font-mono); }
.match-row .label { color: var(--text-dim); }
.match-row .value { color: var(--text); }
.match-row .value.accent { color: var(--accent); }

/* ============ Quote form ============ */
.quote-section { padding: 96px 0; background: var(--bg-alt); border-top: 1px solid var(--border); border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border); }
.quote-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 0.9fr 1.1fr; gap: 70px; align-items: start; }
.quote-intro h2 { font-size: clamp(26px, 3vw, 34px); }
.mini-stats { display: flex; gap: 34px; margin-top: 32px; }
.mini-stats strong { display: block; font-family: var(--font-display); font-size: 24px; color: var(--accent); }
.mini-stats span { font-size: 12.5px; color: var(--text-muted); font-family: var(--font-mono); }

.quote-form {
  background: var(--bg-card);
  border: 1px solid var(--border-strong);
  border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
  padding: 34px;
  box-shadow: var(--shadow-lg);
}
.form-progress { margin-bottom: 26px; }
.step-label { font-family: var(--font-mono); font-size: 12px; color: var(--accent); letter-spacing: 0.04em; text-transform: uppercase; }
.progress-track { height: 4px; background: var(--border); border-radius: 4px; margin-top: 10px; overflow: hidden; }
.progress-fill { height: 100%; width: 33.3%; background: var(--accent); border-radius: 4px; transition: width 0.35s ease; }

.form-step { display: none; }
.form-step.active { display: block; animation: stepIn 0.3s ease; }
@keyframes stepIn { from { opacity: 0; transform: translateX(8px); } to { opacity: 1; transform: translateX(0); } }
.form-step h3 { font-size: 19px; margin-bottom: 20px; }

.choice-row { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; gap: 12px; margin-bottom: 20px; }
.choice-card {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 8px;
  padding: 20px 12px;
  background: var(--bg-alt);
  border: 1px solid var(--border-strong);
  border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
  color: var(--text-muted);
  font-family: var(--font-body);
  font-weight: 600;
  font-size: 14px;
  cursor: pointer;
  transition: all 0.15s ease;
}
.choice-card svg { color: var(--text-muted); transition: color 0.15s ease; }
.choice-card:hover { border-color: var(--border-strong); }
.choice-card.selected { border-color: var(--accent); background: var(--accent-dim); color: var(--accent); }
.choice-card.selected svg { color: var(--accent); }

.field { display: block; margin-bottom: 18px; }
.field span { display: block; font-size: 13px; color: var(--text-muted); margin-bottom: 8px; font-weight: 500; }
.field input, .field select {
  width: 100%;
  background: var(--bg-alt);
  border: 1px solid var(--border-strong);
  color: var(--text);
  font-family: var(--font-body);
  font-size: 14.5px;
  padding: 12px 14px;
  border-radius: 10px;
  transition: border-color 0.15s ease;
}
.field input:focus, .field select:focus { border-color: var(--accent); outline: none; }
.field input::placeholder { color: var(--text-dim); }

.form-nav { display: flex; gap: 12px; margin-top: 8px; }
.form-nav .btn-ghost { flex: 0 0 auto; }
.form-nav .btn-accent { flex: 1; }

.fine-print { font-size: 12px; color: var(--text-dim); margin: 4px 0 18px; }
.fine-print a { color: var(--accent); font-weight: 600; text-decoration: underline; }

.success-step { text-align: center; padding: 20px 0; }
.success-icon {
  width: 60px; height: 60px; border-radius: 50%;
  background: var(--accent-dim);
  color: var(--accent);
  display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
  margin: 0 auto 20px;
}
.success-step h3 { font-size: 21px; }

/* ============ Section head (shared) ============ */
.section-head { max-width: 620px; margin: 0 auto 52px; text-align: center; }
.section-head h2 { font-size: clamp(26px, 3.4vw, 36px); }
.section-head p { font-size: 16px; }

/* ============ Process ============ */
.process { padding: 96px 0; }
.process-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr); gap: 28px; }
.process-card {
  background: linear-gradient(160deg, #F0FBF7, #E4F5EE);
  border: 1px solid rgba(0, 168, 138, 0.16);
  border-radius: var(--radius-md);
  padding: 32px 26px;
  position: relative;
  box-shadow: 0 14px 30px -20px rgba(0, 168, 138, 0.35);
  transition: transform 0.2s ease, box-shadow 0.2s ease;
}
.process-card:hover { transform: translateY(-4px); box-shadow: 0 18px 38px -18px rgba(0, 168, 138, 0.4); }
.process-num {
  font-family: var(--font-mono);
  font-weight: 700;
  font-size: 13px;
  color: #fff;
  background: linear-gradient(135deg, #00A88A, #017E56);
  width: 34px;
  height: 34px;
  border-radius: 10px;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  margin-bottom: 16px;
  letter-spacing: 0.02em;
}
.process-card h3 { font-size: 18px; }
.process-card p { font-size: 14.5px; margin-bottom: 0; }

/* ============ Services ============ */
.services { padding: 96px 0; }
.services-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; gap: 26px; margin-bottom: 60px; }
.service-card {
  background: linear-gradient(180deg, var(--bg-card), var(--bg-alt));
  border: 1px solid var(--border-strong);
  border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
  padding: 34px;
}
.service-icon {
  width: 52px; height: 52px;
  border-radius: 14px;
  background: var(--accent-dim);
  color: var(--accent);
  display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
  margin-bottom: 20px;
}
.service-card h3 { font-size: 21px; }
.tag-row { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 8px; margin-bottom: 26px; }
.tag-row span {
  font-family: var(--font-mono);
  font-size: 12px;
  color: var(--text-muted);
  border: 1px solid var(--border-strong);
  padding: 5px 12px;
  border-radius: 100px;
}
.service-actions { display: flex; gap: 12px; }

.stats-bar {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr);
  gap: 24px;
  background: linear-gradient(135deg, #013A28, #017E56);
  border: none;
  border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
  padding: 40px 20px;
  max-width: 760px;
  margin: 0 auto;
  box-shadow: 0 20px 44px -22px rgba(1, 126, 86, 0.5);
}
.stat { text-align: center; }
.stat strong { display: block; font-family: var(--font-display); font-size: 32px; color: #6FFFD4; margin-bottom: 4px; }
.stat span { font-size: 12.5px; color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.75); font-family: var(--font-mono); }

/* ============ Why us ============ */
.why { padding: 96px 0; }
.why-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr); gap: 24px; }
.why-card {
  border-radius: var(--radius-md);
  padding: 28px 24px;
  box-shadow: 0 10px 26px -18px rgba(16, 19, 31, 0.25);
  transition: transform 0.2s ease, box-shadow 0.2s ease;
}
.why-card:hover { transform: translateY(-4px); box-shadow: 0 18px 36px -18px rgba(16, 19, 31, 0.3); }
.why-card .icon-badge {
  width: 44px;
  height: 44px;
  border-radius: 12px;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  margin-bottom: 16px;
}
.why-card:nth-child(1) { background: #EDFCF7; border: 1px solid #BFEFDF; }
.why-card:nth-child(2) { background: #EFF5FF; border: 1px solid #C6DBFF; }
.why-card:nth-child(3) { background: #FFF7EA; border: 1px solid #FBE3B8; }
.why-card:nth-child(4) { background: #FEF0F6; border: 1px solid #FAD0E4; }
.why-card:nth-child(5) { background: #F5F0FF; border: 1px solid #DBCBFC; }
.why-card:nth-child(6) { background: #EAFAFC; border: 1px solid #BEEAF0; }
.why-card:nth-child(1) .icon-badge { background: #CFF5E7; color: #00A88A; }
.why-card:nth-child(2) .icon-badge { background: #D6E6FF; color: #2E6FE8; }
.why-card:nth-child(3) .icon-badge { background: #FCE7C2; color: #B96E00; }
.why-card:nth-child(4) .icon-badge { background: #FCDAEA; color: #D6417B; }
.why-card:nth-child(5) .icon-badge { background: #E4D8FF; color: #7C4DE0; }
.why-card:nth-child(6) .icon-badge { background: #CDF1F6; color: #0EA5C4; }
.why-card h3 { font-size: 17px; }
.why-card p { font-size: 14px; margin-bottom: 0; }

/* ============ Final CTA ============ */
.final-cta {
  padding: 96px 0;
  background: #9FE8CE;
  border-top: 1px solid rgba(16, 19, 31, 0.12);
  text-align: center;
}
.final-cta-inner h2 { font-size: clamp(26px, 3.4vw, 38px); }
.final-cta-inner p { max-width: 480px; margin: 0 auto 8px; }

/* ============ Footer ============ */
.site-footer { padding: 70px 0 30px; background: var(--navy-card); border-top: 1px solid var(--navy-border-strong); position: relative; }
.site-footer::before { content: ""; position: absolute; top: -1px; left: 0; right: 0; height: 2px; background: linear-gradient(90deg, transparent, var(--navy-accent), transparent); opacity: 0.6; }
.footer-grid {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: 1.4fr 1fr 1fr 1fr;
  gap: 40px;
  padding-bottom: 50px;
}
.footer-brand p { font-size: 13.5px; margin: 14px 0 16px; max-width: 280px; }
.footer-phone { font-family: var(--font-mono); color: var(--accent); font-size: 14px; }
.footer-col h4 { font-family: var(--font-body); font-size: 13px; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.05em; color: var(--accent); margin-bottom: 16px; }
.footer-col a { display: block; font-size: 14px; color: rgba(244, 246, 251, 0.8); margin-bottom: 11px; }
.footer-col a:hover { color: var(--accent); }
.footer-bottom {
  border-top: 1px solid var(--border);
  padding-top: 24px;
  font-size: 13px;
  color: rgba(244, 246, 251, 0.75);
  display: flex;
  justify-content: space-between;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  gap: 10px;
}
.footer-bottom a { color: rgba(244, 246, 251, 0.75); }
.footer-bottom a:hover { color: var(--accent); }

/* ============ Inner pages: breadcrumb + hero banner ============ */
.breadcrumb {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 8px;
  font-family: var(--font-mono);
  font-size: 12.5px;
  color: var(--text-dim);
  margin-bottom: 22px;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
}
.breadcrumb a { color: var(--text-muted); }
.breadcrumb a:hover { color: var(--accent); }
.breadcrumb .sep { opacity: 0.5; }
.breadcrumb .current { color: var(--text); }

.inner-hero {
  padding: 72px 0;
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--navy-border);
  text-align: center;
}
.inner-hero .container { display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; }
.inner-hero h1 { font-size: clamp(30px, 4vw, 44px); max-width: 700px; }
.inner-hero p { max-width: 560px; font-size: 16.5px; }
.inner-hero .hero-cta-row { margin: 26px 0 6px; justify-content: center; }

/* ============ Content sections (inner pages) ============ */
.content-section { padding: 96px 0; }
.content-section.tight { padding: 64px 0; }
.content-columns {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: 1.1fr 0.9fr;
  gap: 56px;
  align-items: start;
}
.content-columns h2 { font-size: clamp(24px, 3vw, 30px); }
.content-columns p { font-size: 15.5px; }

.benefit-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; gap: 16px; }
.benefit-card {
  display: flex;
  gap: 12px;
  align-items: flex-start;
  background: var(--bg-card);
  border: 1px solid var(--border);
  border-radius: var(--radius-md);
  padding: 20px 18px;
}
.benefit-card svg { color: var(--accent); flex-shrink: 0; margin-top: 2px; }
.benefit-card p { margin: 0; font-size: 14.5px; color: var(--text); }

/* ============ Hub pages (Insurance / Home Services listing) ============ */
.hub-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr); gap: 22px; }
.hub-card {
  display: block;
  background: var(--bg-card);
  border: 1px solid var(--border);
  border-radius: var(--radius-md);
  padding: 26px 22px;
  transition: border-color 0.15s ease, transform 0.15s ease;
}
.hub-card:hover { border-color: var(--accent); transform: translateY(-2px); }
.hub-card .service-icon { width: 44px; height: 44px; margin-bottom: 16px; }
.hub-card h3 { font-size: 16.5px; margin-bottom: 6px; }
.hub-card p { font-size: 13.5px; margin-bottom: 0; }
.hub-card .go-link { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; margin-top: 14px; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 600; color: var(--accent); }

/* ============ Related services (bottom of detail pages) ============ */
.related-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(4, 1fr); gap: 14px; }
.related-card {
  display: block;
  text-align: center;
  background: var(--bg-card);
  border: 1px solid var(--border);
  border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
  padding: 18px 12px;
  font-size: 13.5px;
  font-weight: 600;
  color: var(--text-muted);
}
.related-card:hover { border-color: var(--accent); color: var(--accent); }

/* ============ Contact page ============ */
.contact-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 0.9fr 1.1fr; gap: 56px; align-items: start; }
.contact-card {
  background: var(--bg-card);
  border: 1px solid var(--border);
  border-radius: var(--radius-md);
  padding: 24px 22px;
  margin-bottom: 14px;
}
.contact-card h4 { font-family: var(--font-body); font-size: 13px; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.05em; color: var(--text-dim); margin-bottom: 10px; }
.contact-card .value { font-family: var(--font-mono); font-size: 16px; color: var(--text); }
.contact-form {
  background: var(--bg-card);
  border: 1px solid var(--border);
  border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
  padding: 32px;
}
.contact-form .field-row { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; gap: 16px; }

/* ============ Legal pages ============ */
.legal-content { max-width: 760px; }
.legal-content h2 { font-size: 20px; margin-top: 40px; }
.legal-content h2:first-child { margin-top: 0; }
